packageRules.description: Keep NuGet's plain Version="x.y.z" and raise it, instead of the preset's exact pin. In NuGet a plain version means "this or newer", so pinning rewrites it to [newest] and folds major jumps into one unlabelled "pin" PR.

Jellyfin.Controller and Jellyfin.Model are the server API floor, not a dependency to keep current: the plugin compiles against the oldest supported server on purpose. Raise them only with targetAbi in build.yaml (docs/dev/README.md, "When it fails"). server-abi-watch.yml checks each new Jellyfin release instead.
The .NET SDK major follows the net9.0 TargetFramework, which follows the server floor. global.json takes patch and feature-band updates only.
